title: Quick-Fix Rich Uruguayan Russet Potato Pillowy Bakes
description: A rich and satisfying Uruguayan-inspired dish made with pillowy russet potatoes, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. This recipe is sugar-free-friendly and features a delicious yakimono-grill twist.

ingredients.name: Yakimono grill seasoning
ingredients.notes: Available at most Asian markets or online

instructions: Pierce the potatoes several times with a fork to allow steam to escape.
Rub the potatoes with a little bit of oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Place the potatoes directly on the middle rack of the oven and bake for 45 minutes, or until tender when pierced with a fork.
While the potatoes are baking, melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the grated Parmesan cheese to the melted butter and stir until smooth.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Slice the potatoes in half lengthwise and carefully scoop out some of the flesh to make room for the filling.
Fill each potato boat with a spoonful of the melted butter and cheese mixture.
Top each potato with a sprinkle of chopped cilantro and a pinch of paprika.
Drizzle the top of each potato with a little bit of heavy cream and sprinkle with yakimono grill seasoning.
Return the potatoes to the oven and bake for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the tops are golden brown and the filling is heated through.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
